highlights_headline: Upcoming m156 fixes improve clipped paths, glyph replay and Graphite readback.
highlights_body: These native-engine corrections leave the managed API unchanged.

bullets.detail: Corrects Ganesh device-space path bounds and software coverage-mask clamping, plus Graphite clip keys and wedge miter bounds. Fixes convex anti-aliased rasterization buffer overflows and fixed-point overflow for edges far outside the clip, except when built with SK_LEGACY_ALPHA_RUNS.

Validates serialized Slug positions, matrices, bounds and flags, bounds direct-mask offsets, and preserves creation-time rounding during replay. Retains rendering fallbacks for unsuitable glyph data and handles replay when glyph-atlas bilinear filtering is unavailable.
Corrects GPU-to-CPU transfer pixel sizing when reading alpha textures into RGBx destinations, ensuring every destination pixel bit is written.
